questions.answer: The rectangular area is velocity times time: 3.0 x 4.0 = +12 m.

questions.answer: Triangle magnitude = one half x 6.0 x 4.0 = 12 m. It lies below the axis, so displacement is -12 m.

option_feedback.A: This omits the factor one half for a triangle.
option_feedback.B: Correct. The triangle has magnitude 12 m and a negative sign.
option_feedback.C: The magnitude is right, but the below-axis sign is missing.
option_feedback.D: This omits both the triangular factor and the negative sign.

questions.answer: Displacement uses signed areas: 10 - 6 = +4 m. Distance adds magnitudes: 10 + 6 = 16 m.

option_feedback.A: Correct. Signed areas give displacement and magnitudes give distance.
option_feedback.C: This incorrectly lets backward motion reduce distance.
option_feedback.D: This ignores the negative sign when finding displacement.

marking_points.text: For displacement, keep the signs of the graph regions.
